scripts.build: npm install --prefix controlpanel --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build --prefix controlpanel && cp -r controlpanel/dist/assets . && cp controlpanel/dist/controlpanel/index.html controlpanel/index.html

_i18n_note: i18n uses a custom vanilla JS fetch-based loader (src/js/i18n.js). No npm packages required. Locale files live in locales/{module}/{lang}.json
